id: \rAre you getting in the way of my trial?
en: \rAre you getting in the way of my trial?

id: \rLush Jungle has grass Pokémon. Be careful.
en: \rLush Jungle has grass Pokémon. Be careful.
it: \rNella Foresta Ombrosa ci sono Pokémon di tipo Erba. Stai attento.
\bHo perso il mio amico da queste parti.

id: \rOh, good! You and your Pokémon are looking great.
en: \rOh, good! You and your Pokémon are looking great.
it: \rOh, bene! Tu e i tuoi Pokémon siete in gran forma.

id: \bThe Brooklet Trial is around the corner.
en: \bThe Brooklet Trial is around the corner.
it: \bLa prova della Collina Ruscello è dietro l'angolo.

id: \bI managed to beat it after a while. It was hard.
en: \bI managed to beat it after a while. It was hard.
it: \bSono riuscito a superarla dopo un po'. È stata dura.

id: \bTrying to take the back way to Lush Jungle?
en: \bTrying to take the back way to Lush Jungle?
it: \bCerchi di prendere la scorciatoia per la Foresta Ombrosa?

id: \bThe path to Lush Jungle is blocked off. You have to go the long way.
en: \bThe path to Lush Jungle is blocked off. You have to go the long way.
it: \bIl passaggio per la Foresta Ombrosa è bloccato. Devi fare il giro lungo.

id: \rYou'll need at least two Pokémon if you want to battle us.
en: \rYou'll need at least two Pokémon if you want to battle us.
it: \rTi servono almeno due Pokémon se vuoi sfidarci.

id: \rYou go to school? I'm sorry for you.
en: \rYou go to school? I'm sorry for you.
it: \rVai a scuola? Mi dispiace per te.
\rHo catturato i miei Pokémon insieme a Nico.

id: \rI'm always around if you need anything.
en: \rI'm always around if you need anything.
it: \rSono sempre nei paraggi se ti serve qualcosa.
